title: Australian Grilled Chicken Wings
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish perfect for a summer barbecue. Marinated chicken wings are grilled to perfection, served with a side of tangy lemon sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, herb, Australian seasoning, and olive oil.
Add the chicken wings to the marinade, toss to coat, and let sit for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated chicken wings onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the chicken wings for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving.
